officialManifest.policy: Pinned Oct13 official manifest; exact W30 selected item hashes, not family/element guesses.

magazine.description: The number of shots which can be fired before reloading.
magazine.name: Magazine

rpm.description: The number of shots per minute this weapon can fire.
rpm.name: Rounds Per Minute

chargeMillis.description: The time in milliseconds before a weapon fires.
chargeMillis.name: Charge Time

drawMillis.description: The time in milliseconds it takes to draw an arrow. Release an arrow when fully drawn for maximum damage and speed.
drawMillis.name: Draw Time

reloadSpeed.description: The time it takes to reload this weapon.
reloadSpeed.name: Reload Speed

policies.magazine: Exact positive official base stat; absent remains null, no perk/mag interpolation. Sword value is ammo capacity only; supported=false
policies.cadence: FIRING LOCKOUT AFTER FIRST BOLT, excludes subsequent charge: normal single-shot/pellet guns 1200/officialRPM; pulse/burst-sidearm 20*(endFrames+(N-1)*innerFrames)/30; fusion/LFR 20*((N-1)*innerFrames/30+fixedRecoverySeconds). Do not add Oracle charge-like end delay
policies.charge: Official milliseconds only for fusion/LFR; ceil(milliseconds/50), independent from historical Oracle cadence
policies.draw: Official bow Draw Time milliseconds only; ceil(milliseconds/50)
policies.reload: Historical community approximation evpp*x*x+vpp*x+offset seconds; ceil(seconds*20); bow x=min(ReloadSpeed,85); not raw Reload Speed seconds
policies.shell: Only shotguns use per-shell model (classification requires direct-source confirmation; Oracle does not encode granularity). Long Arm retains whole-mag scout approximation: original two-round loading not reconstructed; no verified insert timing
policies.burst: Pulse/sidearm consume per bullet. Fusion/LFR shared ammo per burst; shotgun zero-spacing pellets stay geometry, burstSize=1

limitations: Official base snapshot Oct13 vs historical community curves May20; no current sandbox exactness claim
No perk/armor/frame/exotic animation modifiers; reload quadratics explicitly approximate in source

Shotgun per-shell classification needs independent direct-source confirmation; Oracle does not establish granularity or initial delay. Long Arm keeps whole-mag scout approximation, not an unverified per-insert duration
Unknown/missing values remain null; five swords unsupported, bows have no cadence or official magazine override
Glaive reused Charge Time ignored; ranged cadence/reload/magazine only, no melee timing
ceil to 20 Hz is Minecraft adaptation; fractional cadence and bolt spacing retained to 12 decimals
Pure data/API only; no WeaponProfile, WeaponCycle or runtime integration
